errors.text_span: At 10% sparsity, both bars are near about 5 perplexity (blue slightly below or around 5, orange around 5); at 20% and 30% they remain close to roughly 5–6; at 40% they are around ~6–7; at 50% they are around ~7–8; at 60% the blue bar is just under ~10 while the orange bar is around ~10–11; at 70% the blue bar is around ~20 while the orange bar is around ~40; and at 80% the blue bar reaches roughly ~500 while the orange bar is close to ~900.
errors.evidence: The description provides incorrect perplexity values for several sparsity rates. For example, at 10% sparsity, the values are closer to 2, not 5. At 80%, the blue bar is closer to ~1000, not ~500, and the orange bar is closer to ~1000, not ~900.
The description does not mention that the orange bars are taller than the blue bars at 50%, 60%, 70%, and 80% sparsity rates.
The description does not mention that the bars are not sorted in any particular order beyond the increasing sparsity rate.
The description does not explicitly state that the vertical axis uses a logarithmic scale.
The description does not mention the position of the legend in the top-left corner.
